title: ScadaBankSignal
description: Simulated utility SCADA -> orchestrator, published on <root>/scada/<bank_id>, QoS 0.

signal.description: Per-phase signals (06-service-profiles-and-power-quality.md S6.2) added additively; the schema's one-signal-per-message shape is unchanged -- a per-phase reading is three messages, matching the existing APPARENT_POWER_KVA pattern.

value.description: For REAL_POWER_KW specifically (R3.4, pinned 2026-09-26): signed, + = the bank imports real power from the feeder (net consumption/charging), - = the bank exports to the feeder (net discharge). Every other signal in the enum above is an unsigned magnitude (e.g. APPARENT_POWER_KVA, CURRENT_A).
